task: pick up the cream cheese and place it in the basket

windows.text: Reach the open gripper toward the orange box on the table.
Reach the open gripper toward the orange cream cheese box on the table.
Reach the open gripper horizontally across the table toward the orange cream cheese box.
Approach the cream cheese box from above, lowering the open gripper toward it.
Approach the blue box from above, lowering the open gripper toward it.
Approach the blue cream cheese box from above, lowering the open gripper toward it.
Grasp the blue cream cheese box from above and lift it off the table.
Lift the blue cream cheese box up off the table, raising it above the surrounding cans.
Lift the blue cream cheese box up off the table, moving it toward the basket.
Carry the cream cheese horizontally over the table toward the basket.
Carry the cream cheese horizontally toward the basket.
Lower the cream cheese down into the basket.
Release the blue cream cheese box into the basket and retract the empty gripper upward.
Release the cream cheese into the basket and open the gripper.
Hold the open gripper stationary above the basket.
